craft_notes: FIRST-VERSE VOICE (verdict outstanding — same hand proposed for the whole song-set). Sthāyin: wonder at the giver (adbhuta). Sanskrit first: dative pile (dāyine/śivāya/bhānave) → L4 lands each gift on its own beat, colon after bliss holds the sun back, dash releases it. Rows: row 1 (sun-last — bhānave closes, abyss closes). Rupture: colon after bliss — gift held, giver blazes. Close: end-weight on darkness-cleared. Minimal pass: colon for L3 dash, dash for L3 comma. Read aloud: gift-beat, sun-beat. Rejected: 'all-blessing-full' — killed: mayam is made-of, fullness static; 'gloom' for dhvānta — killed: darkness plain, gloom imports mood.

lines: Bow to the freedom-giver, made of every bliss:
to Śiva — the sun that cleared the becoming's abyss.

reads_against.argmap: The bow goes to the freedom-giver: Śiva, sun that quenched the darkness of the becoming-road.
c1_essence: Bow to the freedom-giver: Śiva, sun against becoming-darkness.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta tipping into śānta (wonder settling into quiescence)
